messages:
Amber (PM): quick thread 1: we need a decision for the education vertical packaging: pure metering vs hybrid SKU + overage. customers keep asking for simple invoices for pilots
Chris (Sales): +1. school districts want predictable monthly lines on POs. per-token kills procurement cycles
Mei (Eng): hybrid is doable: enforce a baseline SKU quota, then fall back to metered billing. infra work: quota service + overage pipeline
Nora (Finance): prefer SKU baseline for revenue recognition and easier ARR math. But need clear mapping: sku -> token band -> unit price for overage
Derek (Legal): procurement teams will need explicit ceilings and a grace period. also some districts require net-30 invoicing and PO line items
billing-bot: Billing config draft uploaded: /billing/drafts/edu-hybrid-2026-03-23.json
Amber (PM): proposal outline:
- SKU: "edu-starter" $29/mo includes 100k tokens
- Overage: $0.00004/token after band
- Add-on: extra route throughput blocks (pilot-only) at $X/hr
- Grace: 7-day soft overage buffer then invoice
Chris (Sales): pilot ask: allow per-school seat pooling under district master SKUs. Sales ops needs exportable csv report per-school
Mei (Eng): implement pooling as logical sub-account mapping to parent SKU. estimate: 2 sprints for quota service, 1 sprint for exports
Nora (Finance): risk: if overage is too cheap customers will intentionally stay on starter. need mid-tier incentive: "edu-plus" $199/mo -> 1M tokens
Amber (PM): gating for pilot (district / university):
- working billing mapping and invoice sample
- legal-side PO language and ceiling clause
- telemetry: per-subaccount token usage + exportable CSV
- 1 pilot signed + instrumented for 4 weeks
Derek (Legal): will draft PO-friendly clause: "billing ceilings, grace overage, net-30" and share in #legal-drafts
Chris (Sales): I'll surface two pilot prospects: Westlake Unified + State University partner. Will confirm next week
Mei (Eng): question: enforcement mode for overage during grace: keep serving + tag usage, then block after grace?
Amber (PM): prefer serve-through grace + email/update + throttle if >2x expected run-rate after grace
Mei (Eng): noted. enforcement proto config:
```
enforcement:
  baseline_sku: edu-starter
  baseline_tokens: 100000
  grace_days: 7
  overage_price_per_token: 0.00004
  post_grace_action: throttle_and_notify
```
Nora (Finance): I'll model the ARR impact for three uptake scenarios and post spreadsheet by Friday
billing-bot: billing-rule applied to sandbox org for pilot testing
Amber (PM): decision: approve hybrid SKU + metered overage pilot for edu. no public launch until telemetry and PO language are validated. assigning follow-ups in linear
Mei (Eng): opening RFC + ticket PRO-4412
Amber (PM): thanks all :white_check_mark:
